phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn to adapt your language to different registers, from informal emails to formal reports and essays.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Compare these sentences. Thanks for your help! I would like to express my gratitude for your assistance. Notice how formality changes vocabulary, structure and tone.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: Which is formal? I am writing to ___ my interest in the position.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Rewrite an informal message as a formal email.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: Choose the informal option: I would appreciate it if / Thanks a lot for
phases.explanation: Thanks a lot is informal; the others are formal.
